notes: Wonderchef is a Shopify store (Kitchen & Dining appliances/cookware). Accessed via direct HTTP (curl) throughout; robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow, standard Shopify disallows only (cart/checkout/account/search/filter params). Investigation covered: (1) main navigation/mega-menu on homepage HTML (curl) - only generic product-type categories (Cookware, Appliances, Mixer Grinder, Air Fryer, etc.) plus 'Gift', 'New Arrivals', 'Monsoon Delights', 'Best Selling', 'Loved by Customers' - no holiday/festival nav items; (2) the /collections/gift page - its sub-links are also all generic product types, no holiday sub-nav; (3) full sitemap_collections_1.xml (893 collection URLs) grepped for every holiday/festival keyword in the rules vocabulary (Diwali, Christmas, Xmas, Holi, Rakhi/Raksha Bandhan, Valentine, Navratri, Dussehra, Ganesh Chaturthi, Makar Sankranti, Eid, Mother's/Father's Day, Independence/Republic Day, Monsoon, Summer, Winter, Wedding, Festival) - this surfaced ~70 candidate URLs with holiday-sounding slugs (e.g. /collections/diwali, /collections/diwali-2, /collections/diwali-offers-2024, /collections/christmas, /collections/christmas-offers, /collections/rakhi-2026, /collections/rakshabandhan, /collections/raksha-bandhan-special, /collections/valentines, /collections/valentines-2026, /collections/ganesh-chaturthi, /collections/makar-sankranti, /collections/navratri-deals-2025, /collections/dussehra-offers-2025, /collections/holi-2025, /collections/holi-2022, /collections/happy-mothers-day, /collections/mothers-day-offers, /collections/fathers-day, /collections/fathers-day-quiz, /collections/79th-independence-day-offers, /collections/republic-day-offer(s), /collections/monsoon-delights, /collections/monsoon-magic, /collections/winter-collection, /collections/summer-essentials, /collections/wedding-gifts, /collections/wedding-gifting, etc.). (4) Verified these are real Shopify collection endpoints, not auto-generated fake pages, by testing a deliberately nonsense slug (/collections/nonsense-slug-xyz123) which returned HTTP 404 and an empty products.json - confirming the 200-status holiday-named collections are genuine store objects, not spoofed. (5) Content-verified via each collection's /products.json endpoint (per the shared engine's collection-sampling method) rather than trusting the URL/title: sampled product titles from diwali-2, diwali-offers-2024, christmas, christmas-special-offer, rakhi-2026, rakhi-special, rakshabandhan, valentines, ganesh-chaturthi, makar-sankranti, dussehra-offers-2025, mothers-day-offers, fathers-day-quiz, holi-2025, navratri-deals-2025, festival-offer, monsoon-delights, winter-collection, summer-essentials, and 79th-independence-day-offers. Every single one of these returned the SAME generic kitchen-appliance/cookware catalog (mixer grinders, espresso/coffee makers, non-stick cookware sets, casseroles, dinner sets, kettles, gas stoves, food processors) with zero occasion-specific products (no diyas, no rangoli items, no Christmas ornaments/tree decor, no rakhi threads, no Valentine-themed items, no Holi-specific items) - i.e. these are storewide gifting/discount campaign collections that get relabeled/re-tagged for whichever festival or gifting occasion is currently being promoted (Diwali, Christmas, Rakhi, Navratri, Dussehra, Ganesh Chaturthi, Makar Sankranti, Holi, Valentine's, Mother's/Father's Day, Independence/Republic Day, Monsoon, Summer, Winter all showed the identical pattern), not genuine occasion-specific seasonal categories. This is precisely the excluded pattern under rules.md SS4/SS17 (storewide sale/offer/campaign pages) and the explicit anti-pattern this task warned against (a holiday-titled URL reused for a generic catalog). The dedicated /collections/diwali and /collections/christmas-2023 and /collections/navratri-day-deal and /collections/festive-gifting-collection URLs returned 0 products (dead/retired campaign pages). No genuine Diwali-, Christmas-, Rakhi-, Holi-, or other-festival-specific PRODUCT category (e.g. 'Diwali Diyas', 'Diwali Gift Sets curated for the festival', 'Christmas Ornaments') exists anywhere in the discovered taxonomy - only generic-catalog campaign pages under festival-named URLs. Concluding NO_SEASONAL after this real investigation across nav, mega-menu, full collections sitemap keyword sweep, and content sampling of every plausible candidate.
